title: 高三单遍：雨伞、展厅与旧相机
source_notice: 参照高三山东公开读者层第一节：五独立短对话各一题三选、每段一遍、听后十秒兼作本题作答与读下一题，本节未印已解示例。网页称期中，正文为2025届第二次诊断/2024.11，原校发布未认证；题面、印出脚本和键可核，原录音缺，普通HTTP500，不绕门取文件。与高三既有两遍/已解示例模式分开，不能按年级统一复用播放次数。全部对话、问题、候选和合成音轨为原创；本机审阅可重播，不当自然语流、年级/难度等值、独立教研、学生、商用或生产通过。
instruction: 听五段独立短对话，每段一题，从A、B、C中选最佳答案。每段一遍，听后10秒兼作本题作答与读下一题；本组不含已解示例。审阅页面可重播。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The rain has started, and I left my umbrella at home. I suppose I’ll have to buy another one.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: There’s no need. You can borrow mine from the office. I’m staying here until the rain stops.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Thanks. I’ll bring it back tomorrow morning.

questions.stem: What does the woman offer to do?
options: Drive the man to his house.
questions.rationale: A：明确no need买，不是出售；B：you can borrow mine明确借伞；C：未提出开车送回家

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: I’d like to visit the gallery on Tuesday, but the website says the student tour is full.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: That tour is full, but you can still visit the rooms on your own. Only the guided group needs advance booking.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Then I’ll go without joining the tour.

options: Cancel her visit to the gallery.
Book a place on the full tour.
questions.rationale: A：末句明确自行参观；B：没有取消参观，只不参加导览；C：已满组未订到，也无需订自行参观

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Could you read the last sentence again? There was a noise from the corridor just as you finished.

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Of course. Should I start the whole interview again?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: No, just that sentence. I can join the clean recording to the earlier part when I edit the programme.

options: Taking notes during a public lecture.
questions.rationale: A：要求重录并剪辑，不是批改书面作业；B：已在控制录音采访，不只是听公开讲座记笔记；C：clean recording与edit programme共同支持录制节目素材

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: The second-hand camera takes clear pictures, but the carrying bag is scratched. Should I buy a new camera instead?

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The bag isn’t what takes the pictures. If the camera works well, I wouldn’t pay twice as much just for a neat bag.

options: Choosing the cheaper camera despite its bag.
Paying extra for a camera with a new bag.
Giving up photography until prices fall.
questions.rationale: A：相机运作好，不为包的划痕多付一倍价，A准确；B：明确不为包更整洁多付；C：没有建议放弃摄影或等待降价

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: The board says our train leaves in five minutes. Are we at the right platform?

turns.speaker: W
turns.text: Yes, platform six. I’ve just checked with the staff by the ticket barriers. We only need to walk past those two carriages.

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Good. Let’s hurry before the doors close.

questions.stem: Where are the speakers most probably?
questions.rationale: A：platform、carriages不是电影院设施；B：train/platform/ticket barriers/carriages共同限定车站；C：没有公路服务区情境
